Dear e2e challenge organizer team,

I have a question concerning the tech report.

The current template gives a predefined section structure consisting of
- Abstract
- Method summary
- Policy description
- Resources and training
- Runtime and reproducibility
- Limitations and safety considerations

Each section also expects certain content.

Since the current structure differs a bit from a typical paper structure (abstract, introduction, related works, method, experimental setup, experimental results, conclusion), i have the following question(s):
How strictly should we follow the structure? Are we allowed to change section titles? Add/move/remove sections? Or should we follow the exact structure as is?

PS: I'm aware that if we change the structure, we should still make sure to include all necessary information (e.g., datasets, policy, limitations, ...).

new_candidates.body:
**Problem**
`stripJSON5` in `test/integration/config_runner_test.go` applies its regexes
(trailing-comma removal and bare-key quoting) to the whole file, including
the inside of string literals. A test case can therefore end up checking
something different from what was written, or fail to parse.

**Steps to reproduce**
Pass these through `stripJSON5` and `json.Unmarshal`:

1. `{ text: "wait, }" }` → decoded as `"wait }"` (silent change; valid JSON,
   so an `arg_contains` check would assert on the wrong substring)
2. `{ description: "hello, name: John" }` → `{ "description": "hello, "name": John" }`
   (invalid JSON: `invalid character 'n' after object key:value pair`)

Also, `commentIndex` does not handle `\"`, so
`"say \" // not a comment"` is cut at the `//`.

**Impact**
Latent: none of the current files in `testdata/` contain such strings (I
checked all of them; output is byte-identical before/after my fix). It will
hit the first test case whose strings contain `, word:` or `, }` / `, ]`.

**Proposed fix**
Apply the rewrites only outside string literals and make `commentIndex`
escape-aware. No new dependencies. I'd like to work on this.

**Environment:** <OS>, Go <version>
new_candidates.title: integration tests: stripJSON5 corrupts string values in test-case files

Please try rc2 and address any migration warnings. Feel free to report feedback or issues in the [Hydra repository](https://github.com/hydra-ecosystem/hydra/issues).

Thanks!  
Omry
